_comment: pi-crew's six bundled agents hardcode openai-codex/* models in their frontmatter and pi-crew
fails a spawn outright when a configured model does not resolve exactly, so every bundled
agent needs an override regardless of which provider is active. The entrypoint patches
model/thinking here on every run from PI_PROVIDER/PI_MODEL/PI_THINKING, and adds a
`thinking` entry for any agent named by a PI_THINKING_<AGENT> env var.
The five agents defined in agents/*.md omit `model` on purpose and inherit the current one.
